entries.title: A secret you paste keeps its line breaks
entries.body: Pasting a value that spans several lines, such as a private key or a certificate, into a secret's value in Settings or into the field a crewmate's request for a secret shows used to join its lines into one, so a command that used the secret could fail. The value is now kept and handed to commands exactly as you pasted it, and it stays hidden as before.
entries.noPicture: The field looks the same, with every character hidden; only the value it keeps changes.
